opening.argument: The speaker presents joining BitClub Network as a way to receive cryptocurrency-mining proceeds without purchasing or operating the equipment, stating that “we purchased the equipment and software for you and pay the overhead needed to mine cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.” The pitch then links greater earning potential to recruitment: “when you introduce a new member to BitClub ... you'll earn even more,” and claims, “The more people you share BitClub with, the greater your earning potential.” It closes by directing viewers to “contact the person who invited you to view this video and get started today.”
